name: efactura-submissions-001-baseline
statements: CREATE TABLE efactura_submissions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,environment TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_environment_valid CHECK(environment IN('test','prod')),document_kind TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_document_kind_valid CHECK(document_kind IN('invoice','correction')),document_id TEXT NOT NULL,standard TEXT NOT NULL,cif TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_cif_digits CHECK(cif ~ '^[0-9]{2,10}$'),buyer_is_individual BOOLEAN NOT NULL,xml BYTEA NOT NULL,xml_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_xml_sha256_matches CHECK(xml_sha256=encode(sha256(xml),'hex')),xml_size INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_xml_size_valid CHECK(xml_size>=1 AND xml_size<=10485760 AND xml_size=octet_length(xml)),state TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_state_valid CHECK(state IN('queued','validating','uploading','processing','accepted','rejected','refused','unknown')),upload_index TEXT CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_upload_index_digits CHECK(upload_index ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$'),download_id TEXT CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_download_id_digits CHECK(download_id ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$'),archive_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_archive_state_valid CHECK(archive_state IN('none','pending','stored')),polls INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_polls_nonnegative CHECK(polls>=0),next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL,errors TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_errors_array CHECK(jsonb_typeof(errors::jsonb)='array'),superseded BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,created_by TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_standard_matches_kind CHECK((document_kind='invoice' AND standard='UBL') OR (document_kind='correction' AND standard='CN')),CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_upload_index_by_state CHECK(CASE WHEN state IN('processing','accepted','rejected') THEN upload_index IS NOT NULL WHEN state='refused' THEN true ELSE upload_index IS NULL END),CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_download_id_by_state CHECK((download_id IS NOT NULL)=(state IN('accepted','rejected'))),CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_archive_by_state CHECK((archive_state<>'none')=(state IN('accepted','rejected'))),CONSTRAINT efactura_submissions_superseded_only_unknown CHECK(NOT superseded OR state='unknown'))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX efactura_submissions_current ON efactura_submissions(organization_id,environment,document_kind,document_id) WHERE NOT superseded AND state IN('queued','validating','uploading','processing','accepted','unknown')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX efactura_submissions_upload_index ON efactura_submissions(organization_id,environment,upload_index) WHERE upload_index IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX efactura_submissions_document ON efactura_submissions(organization_id,document_kind,document_id)
CREATE INDEX efactura_submissions_due ON efactura_submissions(next_attempt_at) WHERE state IN('queued','validating','processing') OR archive_state='pending'

CREATE TABLE efactura_resubmissions(previous_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES efactura_submissions(id),next_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES efactura_submissions(id),organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,duplicate_risk_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_resubmissions_confirmed CHECK(duplicate_risk_confirmed),CONSTRAINT efactura_resubmissions_distinct CHECK(previous_id<>next_id))

CREATE TABLE efactura_submission_attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,submission_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES efactura_submissions(id),organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,operation TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_submission_attempts_operation_valid CHECK(operation IN('validare','upload','stareMesaj','descarcare','listaMesaje')),outcome TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_submission_attempts_outcome_valid CHECK(outcome IN('answered','anaf_error','auth_refused','rate_limited','unrecognized','not_sent','ambiguous')),http_status INTEGER CONSTRAINT efactura_submission_attempts_http_status_valid CHECK(http_status BETWEEN 100 AND 599),duration_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_submission_attempts_duration_nonnegative CHECK(duration_ms>=0),started_at TEXT NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT efactura_submission_attempts_status_when_answered CHECK(outcome IN('not_sent','ambiguous') OR http_status IS NOT NULL))
CREATE INDEX efactura_submission_attempts_submission ON efactura_submission_attempts(submission_id)

CREATE TABLE efactura_responses(submission_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES efactura_submissions(id),organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,download_id TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_responses_download_id_digits CHECK(download_id ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$'),archive BYTEA NOT NULL,sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_responses_sha256_matches CHECK(sha256=encode(sha256(archive),'hex')),size INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_responses_size_valid CHECK(size>=1 AND size<=11534336 AND size=octet_length(archive)),stored_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE efactura_dispatcher_epoch(singleton BOOLEAN PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CONSTRAINT efactura_dispatcher_epoch_singleton CHECK(singleton),epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_dispatcher_epoch_positive CHECK(epoch>0),acquired_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE efactura_message_budgets(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,operation TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_message_budgets_operation_valid CHECK(operation IN('stareMesaj','descarcare')),message_id TEXT NOT NULL,day TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_message_budgets_day_shape CHECK(day ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),used INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_message_budgets_used_within_limit CHECK(used BETWEEN 1 AND CASE operation WHEN 'stareMesaj' THEN 90 ELSE 9 END),PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,operation,message_id))

CREATE TABLE efactura_rate_limits(organization_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,minute TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_rate_limits_minute_shape CHECK(minute ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$'),used INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_rate_limits_used_within_limit CHECK(used BETWEEN 0 AND 900),paused_until TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER efactura_submissions_content_no_update BEFORE UPDATE OF organization_id,environment,document_kind,document_id,standard,cif,buyer_is_individual,xml,xml_sha256,xml_size,created_by,created_at ON efactura_submissions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('e-Factura submission content is immutable')
CREATE TRIGGER efactura_submissions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON efactura_submissions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('e-Factura submissions are kept')
CREATE TRIGGER efactura_resubmissions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON efactura_resubmissions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('e-Factura resubmissions are append-only')
CREATE TRIGGER efactura_resubmissions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON efactura_resubmissions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('e-Factura resubmissions are append-only')
CREATE TRIGGER efactura_submission_attempts_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON efactura_submission_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('e-Factura call log is append-only')
CREATE TRIGGER efactura_submission_attempts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON efactura_submission_attempts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('e-Factura call log is append-only')
CREATE TRIGGER efactura_responses_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON efactura_responses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('e-Factura responses are immutable')
CREATE TRIGGER efactura_responses_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON efactura_responses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('e-Factura responses are immutable')
